summary.text: Jordan Varnadore is the Republican candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 71, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Ocean Fitts and independent Joseph Hoolihan; there is no incumbent in the race.
Varnadore won the August 18, 2026 Republican primary with 62.4 percent of the vote over Melton Little and Dylan Modarelli.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists the Florida Chamber of Commerce among the organizations that endorsed Jordan Varnadore in the 2026 race.
